title: Data sync
subtitle: Compare a store's data to HQ and reconcile it: campaigns of per-store jobs, run from pre-configured profiles.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant to view data sync. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

banner.stateDbUnreachable: DataSync's state database is unreachable. Campaigns cannot be read or advanced until it is back.
banner.workerDisabled: DataSync's worker is turned off. Campaigns will not advance until it is turned on.
banner.workerStale: DataSync's worker has not ticked since <at>{{at}}</at>. Running campaigns may be stalled, not slow.
banner.workerNeverTicked: DataSync's worker has not ticked yet. Running campaigns may be stalled, not slow.

campaign.Pause: Pause takes effect at the next chunk boundary: running jobs show Pausing until they reach it, then Paused. Queued jobs are simply not started.
campaign.Resume: Resume re-queues the jobs a person paused. Jobs held because their store became busy resume on their own once it is safe.
campaign.Cancel: Cancel stops every job that has not finished. Running jobs stop at the next chunk boundary (Cancelling, then Cancelled). Chunks already applied to a store are never rolled back.

job.Pause: Pause takes effect at the next chunk boundary: a running job shows Pausing until it reaches it, then Paused. A queued job is paused at once.
job.Resume: Resume puts the job back in the queue. An apply job checks again that its store is safe to write to.
job.Cancel: Cancel stops the job. A running job stops at the next chunk boundary (Cancelling, then Cancelled). Chunks already applied to the store are never rolled back.
